definition: The predecessor relation between actually existing supporters and supported individuals at w₀ is well-founded in Lean's inductive sense. This excludes its cycles and unending predecessor descent; it does not assert that time or the carrier of beings is finite.
note: Mathematical condition on DEF-PRESENT-ESSE-SUPPORT, not independently justified metaphysics. In particular, a family of separate worldwise well-founded relations may have a non-well-founded union.
